summary: Expose Element.classList as a live SameObject DOMTokenList view over the class attribute.

semantics.liveness: changes through class attribute and DOMTokenList are mutually visible
semantics.tokenization: ASCII whitespace-separated tokens; duplicates normalized by token-list algorithms

caveats: Returning a copied List<string> breaks liveness and identity.
references: WHATWG DOM Living Standard § Element.classList / DOMTokenList

tests.name: live with class attribute
tests.input: const e=document.createElement('div'); const c=e.classList; e.setAttribute('class','a b'); console.log(c.contains('b'));
